cards.title: Undergraduate research supervision
paragraphs: Undergraduate students can take part in research projects in nuclear physics, mathematical modelling, scientific computing, data analysis and uncertainty quantification. Projects are built around the methods used in the research programme, adapted to the level of the student.

cards.title: What a student might do
bullets: Build a small simulation in Python and test it against a known result
Fit a model to data and report the uncertainty of the fitted parameters
Solve the equations of motion of a simple system numerically
Analyse, plot and interpret a data set

cards.title: Possible final-year project themes
bullets: Simulating a random walk and diffusion to introduce stochastic dynamics
Fitting models to data and quantifying parameter uncertainty
Numerical solution of the equations of motion for a simple physical system
Python tools for analysing and plotting nuclear data
cards.note: Interested students should get in touch through the [contact details](contact.html).
